ensembles.name: the harbour at night: navy sky, moon, far shore of sheds with a crane and two masts, black water with lamp streaks
the inner harbour quay: wet stone paving to a lip over black water, two town lamps, bollards, a ladder down the wall
the quay path east at first light: stone kerb with a light strip, worn prints running to the harbour mouth
the quay path sky re-banding from navy to apricot, the half sun at the harbour mouth
the lit phone booth on the quay: steel frame, glass, the warm roof light, a street lamp, the curb and two suitcases
the wet club sidewalk: shopfronts with painted neon, doors in teal and red, wires overhead, gloss floor
the harbour notice board on its post: chalk board, the next-gate time chalked on a strip
mother's living room: the wall with the big window onto the harbour sidewalk, curtains, the floral armchair, side table with the corded phone, a warm lamp
club dancers in a loose ring, colliding and closing gaps
